name: Kesari Saunf Mouth Fresheners – 180gm
original_description:
Introducing Kesari Saunf Mouth Freshener by ZAARA Herbals, a traditional Indian mouth revitalizer meticulously crafted from a harmonious fusion of natural constituents, featuring saunf (fennel seeds) and kesar (saffron). Saunf, renowned for its sweet and aromatic allure, assumes a revered position in traditional Ayurvedic medicine, recognized for its dual attributes as a digestive aid and breath rejuvenator. Meanwhile, kesar, a treasured spice celebrated for its delicate floral notes and vibrant yellow hue, plays a pivotal role in traditional Indian gastronomic and medicinal traditions.

Kesari Saunf Mouth Freshener delivers an exhilarating burst of flavor and freshness, adroitly countering undesirable breath, and leaving the palate invigorated. Its user-friendly, portable packaging ensures effortless enjoyment, allowing you to relish its benefits wherever your journey takes you.

Benefits of Kesari Saunf:

  • Rooted in the rich tapestry of Indian tradition, it unites the potency of natural elements, incorporating saunf (fennel seeds) and kesar (saffron).
  • Saunf, with its sweet and aromatic profile, stands as a cherished component in traditional Ayurvedic medicine, serving the dual purpose of aiding digestion and revitalizing the breath.
  • Kesar, revered for its gentle floral flavor and striking yellow pigment, holds a versatile role in both Indian culinary arts and the realm of ancient medicine.
  • Indulge in a symphony of flavors and freshness, effectively vanquishing unpleasant breath and enlivening the palate.
Ingredients:
  1. Sugar
  2. Fennel seeds
  3. Sugar-coated saunf (fennel seeds)
  4. Sugar balls
